description: Kernel subsystem that measures file hashes at access time and optionally enforces an integrity policy. EVM extends this with extended attribute protection. Creates an audit trail of all executed code.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Modified binaries detected/blocked at execution time

verification.method: Check IMA policy is loaded and enforcing

remediation.name: IMA appraise policy with enforce mode via boot parameter

steps.description: Enable IMA appraise in enforce mode by adding kernel boot parameters (ima_policy=appraise_tcb loads the default TCB appraise policy; ima_appraise=enforce rejects files that fail integrity checks instead of just logging)
Label all existing files with IMA extended attributes so they pass appraisal after reboot (this signs every file on the system with its current hash — run BEFORE rebooting into enforce mode)
steps.command: find / -fstype ext4 -o -fstype xfs | xargs -P4 evmctl ima_hash --hashalgo sha256 2>/dev/null

steps.description: Reboot to activate IMA appraise enforce mode

references.source: RHEL 9 — Enhancing system security with IMA and EVM

remediation.name: Custom IMA measurement and appraisal policy loaded at runtime

steps.description: Create a custom IMA policy file that measures and appraises all executed files and shared libraries (the policy cannot be unloaded once written to the kernel — only appended)
steps.command:
printf 'measure func=BPRM_CHECK
measure func=MMAP_CHECK mask=MAY_EXEC
appraise func=BPRM_CHECK fowner=0
appraise func=MMAP_CHECK mask=MAY_EXEC fowner=0
' > /etc/ima/ima-policy

steps.description: Load the custom IMA policy into the kernel (NOTE: IMA policy is append-only — rules cannot be removed once loaded, only overridden by a reboot)

references.source: RHEL 9 — Enhancing system security with IMA and EVM
